title: Surrey Happy Hour (Local Menu Search Platform)
problem: Surrey diners need a faster way to compare menu prices and find happy-hour options that are available right now.
solution: Built and deployed a Next.js/PostgreSQL application that searches 2,300+ menu items across 100+ Surrey restaurants and ranks results by price and real-time happy-hour availability. Developed structured data-ingestion and admin-review workflows and deployed the containerized platform on Oracle Cloud with Docker and Caddy.
result: Created a single local search experience for comparing Surrey restaurant menu prices and currently available happy-hour deals.

title: UnSigned (Anonymous Messaging Platform)
problem: Users need a simple way to share personalized links and receive anonymous feedback or messages.
solution: Built a web application with a customizable admin dashboard, user management, moderation controls, and multi-language support.
result: Renamed and deployed the platform as UnSigned on its own domain.

title: Minimal YTube (Chrome Extension)
problem: YouTube pages can be distraction-heavy and reduce focus on the currently playing video.
solution: Built a Chrome extension to remove non-essential YouTube fields and keep attention on active content.
result: Created a focused viewing experience by minimizing visual distractions.
